About NexoIQ

A focused consultancy for data and ERP

NexoIQ is a Netherlands-based technology consultancy, registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce and based in the Rotterdam area.

Our story

Data engineering experience, applied to the ERP

NexoIQ was founded by Ahmad Alhashimi, a data engineer and ERP consultant with more than eight years of experience in enterprise data platforms — in manufacturing, insurance and international programmes.

That background shapes how NexoIQ works on Odoo: business processes and data quality are designed together, so the ERP that runs your operation also feeds reliable reporting.

NexoIQ works directly with clients, and alongside internal IT teams, Odoo partners and other consultancies.

Ahmad Alhashimi

Founder · Data & ERP Consultant

Background includes Azure Databricks, Power BI, SAP data integration, Odoo and Microsoft Dynamics 365.

Working with NexoIQ

What you can expect

Direct access

You work directly with the consultant doing the work.

Clear scope

Agreed scope, estimates and regular progress updates.

Honest advice

Including when a simpler or standard solution is enough.

Confidentiality

Careful handling of your data and business information.

Where we work

From the Netherlands to Saudi Arabia and the GCC

Based in the Netherlands, NexoIQ supports businesses across the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, and the GCC through flexible remote consulting and project-based engagements.

NexoIQ is registered in the Netherlands. Clients outside the Netherlands are served remotely; NexoIQ has no office or legal entity in Saudi Arabia or other GCC countries.
